function depositForSwap(uint256 usdtAmount, address xodeBeneficiary, uint256 minXonOut)
function refund(uint256 nonce, address depositor, uint256 usdtAmount, bool chargeFee)
function setRefundAddress(uint256 nonce, uint256 usdtAmount, address to)
event ChangeQueued(bytes32 indexed id, bytes call, uint256 readyAt)
event Deposited(address indexed depositor, address indexed xodeBeneficiary, uint256 usdtAmount, uint256 indexed depositNonce)
event GuardianTransferred(address indexed previousGuardian, address indexed guardian)
event OwnerTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner)
event OwnershipTransferStarted(address indexed owner, address indexed pendingOwner)
event RefundAddressSet(uint256 indexed depositNonce, address indexed to)
event Refunded(uint256 indexed depositNonce, address indexed depositor, address indexed to, uint256 paid, uint256 fee)
event SwapDeposited(address indexed depositor, address indexed xodeBeneficiary, uint256 usdtAmount, uint256 indexed depositNonce, uint256 minXonOut)
event TreasuryChangeProposed(address indexed treasury, uint256 readyAt)
event TreasuryChanged(address indexed previousTreasury, address indexed treasury)
event Withdrawn(address indexed to, uint256 amount)
